derivation_note: Derived bottom-up from TF-IDF+KMeans clustering (k=9) over 27,393 opening customer messages (scripts/02_build_taxonomy.py -> scripts/out/cluster_review.md), then hand-consolidated. Raw clusters were noisy on short tweets (expected for sparse TF-IDF on <280-char text): several clusters mixed technical bugs with feature requests, and one catch-all cluster held ~38% of messages. Clusters were used as evidence, not taken verbatim -- see DECISIONS.md.

intents.name: Account Access & Security
intents.description: Login failures, password resets, username/email changes, suspected account compromise/hacking.

intents.name: Billing & Subscription
intents.description: Premium charges, failed/duplicate payments, student or family-plan discounts, family plan invites, refunds, upgrade/downgrade issues.

intents.name: Playback & Technical Bug
intents.description: App crashes/freezes, playback errors, download/sync failures, device or platform compatibility problems (iOS, Android, watch, smart speakers, consoles).

intents.name: Content Availability & Licensing
intents.description: Specific song/album/artist/podcast missing, removed, or unavailable in the user's region; licensing questions.

intents.name: Feature Request
intents.description: Explicit asks for new features, UI changes, or product behavior changes.

intents.name: General Feedback / Complaint
intents.description: Opinions, venting, or complaints about product decisions (curation, algorithm, price, recent changes) that aren't a discrete bug to fix.

intents.name: General Inquiry
intents.description: Informational questions not tied to a personal problem: how something works, availability of the service itself, careers, praise/thanks, small talk.

intents.name: Other / Unclear
intents.description: Doesn't fit the above, ambiguous, non-English, or too little signal to classify confidently.
